SELECT
  p.brand,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS total_sold
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s

body.value: CONTOSO SOLD MORE — 38,431,107.32 USD against Fabrikam's 19,594,532.31, read directly off the two rows my query returned (38431107.31785 and 19594532.30885, rounded to cents). The figure on each row is how much money that brand took after discount over every sale on record: ten years of orders from 2016-05-18 to 2025-12-31, in both the physical shops and the web shop, in USD. Contoso's total comes off 59,896 order lines across 45,125 orders, Fabrikam's off 10,211 lines across 9,668 orders. Contoso leads by 18,836,575.01, which is 1.96 times Fabrikam. WHAT IS NOT IN THESE FIGURES: the other nine brands, which carry the remaining 160,788,832.03 of the warehouse's 218,814,471.66 all-time net — this answers which of the two named brands is bigger, not which brand is biggest. The amounts are NET, after discount; at list price the same sales read 40,819,628.88 and 20,843,824.25. They are money, not volume — in units the gap is far wider, 188,032 against 31,748, because Contoso's average article is much cheaper. No date, channel, store, country or category restriction was applied, and no currency conversion was done.

Contoso's total comes off 59,896 order lines across 45,125 orders, Fabrikam's off 10,211 lines across 9,668 orders. Contoso leads by 18,836,575.01, which is 1.96 times Fabrikam. WHAT IS NOT IN THESE FIGURES: the other nine brands, which carry the remaining 160,788,832.03 of the warehouse's 218,814,471.66 all-time net — this answers which of the two named brands is bigger, not which brand is biggest. The amounts are NET, after discount; at list price the same sales read 40,819,628.88 and 20,843,824.25. They are money, not volume — in units the gap is far wider, 188,032 against 31,748, because Contoso's average article is much cheaper. No date, channel, store, country or category restriction was applied, and no currency conversion was done.

turns.did:
SELECT
  p.brand,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS total_sold
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  ON s.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE
  p.brand IN ('Contoso', 'Fabrikam')
GROUP BY
  p.brand
ORDER BY
  total_sold DESC

value.sql:
SELECT
  MAX(total_sold) - MIN(total_sold) AS lead
FROM (
  SELECT
    p.brand,
    SUM(s.net_amount) AS total_sold
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
  JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
    ON s.product_key = p.product_key
  WHERE
    p.brand IN ('Contoso', 'Fabrikam')
  GROUP BY
    p.brand
)
value.means: How much more money the leading brand took than the trailing one: Contoso is ahead of Fabrikam by 18,836,575.01 USD after discount, over all ten years of sales (2016-05-18 to 2025-12-31) across both the shops and the web shop. That is 38,431,107.32 minus 19,594,532.31 — Contoso's total is 1.96 times Fabrikam's, so the lead is very nearly as large as Fabrikam's entire ten-year trade. ONE FIGURE, NOT A PER-YEAR OR PER-CHANNEL GAP: it is the difference between two all-time totals, and it says nothing about whether the gap has been widening or narrowing. The size of the lead does depend on what "sold" means, even though the winner does not: at list price before discount the lead is 19,975,804.63, in profit it is 10,670,248.38, and in units it is 156,284 units — where Contoso is 5.92 times Fabrikam rather than 1.96, because its average article is much cheaper.
